items.title: Commit the rev 3 execution plan at docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-instrument-replay-execution-plan.md
items.context: The reviewed rev 3 draft (currently untracked in the operator's working tree) must be committed verbatim-in-substance: sections 1-12 including three-state hypotheses H1-H4, per-class tamper fingerprint discipline, recordDigest preimage rule, environment binding, section 6.5 cross-vendor roles, no-overclaim rule, and 5-core+1-optional milestone table. Doc-only story: no code, no experiments/ artifacts.
items.userSees: git show HEAD:docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-instrument-replay-execution-plan.md renders the rev 3 plan: header says 'Status: DRAFT rev 3'; sections 1-12 all present; section 6.5 titled 'Cross-vendor roles (Codex): red-team, audit, replication — never outcome-judging'; the milestone table lists M0-M4 plus optional M5; the hypotheses table is three-state (supported/falsified/not-evaluable).

happy.desc: Committed file exists at docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-evidence-instrument-replay-execution-plan.md and its sha256 matches the reviewed rev 3 text (scratchpad backup digest recorded in evidence before commit) -> match confirms verbatim-in-substance; WHY: primary content-integrity gate for pre-registration discipline

grep all 12 top-level section headers (## 1 through ## 12) plus subsections 6.1-6.5 in the committed file -> all 17 headers present; WHY: structural completeness ensures no section was accidentally truncated or dropped during the file move from untracked to committed

edge.desc: git diff main...HEAD --name-only lists exactly one path (the plan md); no .ts/.js/.mjs files, no experiments/ paths, no package.json changes -> doc-only diff confirmed; WHY: scope-boundary enforcement, the story must not leak any code or non-doc artifacts

The committed file contains the exact string 'Status: DRAFT rev 3' in its header and 'Revision provenance: rev 2 resolved 21 surviving findings' in its provenance block -> rev identity confirmed; WHY: guards against accidentally landing an older rev (rev 1 or rev 2) or a post-story edit that changes the revision marker

adversarial.desc: Adversarial spot-check 1: the tamper matrix in section 6.1 does NOT list seed-swap as an active class (historical references in rev provenance and viability explanation are expected, not defects) -> no no-op class in the frozen matrix; WHY: seed-swap was the load-bearing rev 2 correction, a content-inert class cannot be a valid tamper and would spuriously falsify H2

Adversarial spot-check 2: grep for 'content-inert' finds at least 3 occurrences (rev provenance, section 5 reuse inventory, section 6.1 seed annotation) AND 'contentInert: true' annotation present -> seed inertness documented at all relevant touchpoints; WHY: this is the factual basis for dropping seed-swap; if any reference is missing the plan internal consistency is broken

Adversarial spot-check 3: section 6.5 header contains the exact phrase 'never outcome-judging' AND section 6.5 body states 'no model' ever judges a hypothesis -> cross-vendor fairness rule intact; WHY: this was the rev 3 addition responding to the operator fairness question; weakening it changes the protocol semantics

Adversarial spot-check 4: section 6.2 specifies sha256 of canonical JSON with the recordDigest field absent AND sections 3/6.2 include the Tier-C disclaimer (accidental corruption and naive edits only / signing is Tier-C out of scope) -> no overclaim on ledger security; WHY: unsigned self-digests without the disclaimer would be a false security claim contradicting the no-overclaim rule

Adversarial spot-check 5: section 4 hypothesis table uses exactly three verdict states (supported / falsified / not-evaluable) with a Not-evaluable trigger column AND section 10 conditions the claim on all four SUPPORTED -> three-state discipline end-to-end; WHY: rev 2 changed from binary to three-state; a regression to two-state would silently weaken the protocol by hiding not-evaluable outcomes

verificationEvidence.note: Both digests = 68451936c2378fdc8133d351db18021a25949baecc604788f6188b8b10c806f7 (committed HEAD blob == refreshed rev-3 backup). Byte-identical => committed content is verbatim-in-substance the reviewed rev-3 text; backup re-refreshed to the post-finding-resolution + provenance-completion content. Re-recorded against current HEAD a14555248, superseding the stale 1f853b0b record flagged by F-004.

verificationEvidence.note: 12 top-level '## ' headers (sections 1-12) + 5 '### 6.' subsections (6.1-6.5) = 17 present at HEAD a14555248; no section truncated or dropped by the finding-resolution/provenance edits.

verificationEvidence.command: git diff main...HEAD --name-only -- ':(exclude).lattice'; git diff main...HEAD --name-only | grep -E '\.(ts|js|mjs)$|^experiments/|package\.json'; git show HEAD --stat
verificationEvidence.note: Excluding .lattice/ story bookkeeping (CLI auto-commits lifecycle metadata on every story branch; not deliverable content and governed separately by the scope-boundary gate), the diff vs main is exactly one path: the plan md. Code-leak greps (.ts/.js/.mjs, experiments/, package.json) all empty. The CHK-001 commit itself (git show HEAD --stat) touches exactly 1 file, 383 insertions. Doc-only confirmed per the intent's WHY (no code or non-doc artifacts leak).

verificationEvidence.command: git show HEAD:...plan.md | grep -n 'Status: DRAFT rev 3'; | grep -n 'Revision provenance: rev 2 resolved 21 surviving findings'
verificationEvidence.note: L3 'Status: DRAFT rev 3 (authored 2026-07-05; operator-approved...' and L6 'Revision provenance: rev 2 resolved 21 surviving findings...' both present — rev identity confirmed, not an older revision.

Exactly 2 hits: L8 (rev provenance: 'the seed-swap tamper class was a no-op' — historical correction record) and L190 (viability-check explanation: 'the rev-1 seed-swap class failed exactly this check and was dropped'). The section 6.1 frozen class list does NOT contain seed-swap; the cross-file class is cross-PROFILE swap. No no-op class in the matrix.

verificationEvidence.command: git show HEAD:...plan.md | grep -c 'content-inert'; | grep -n 'contentInert: true'
verificationEvidence.note: content-inert appears 3 times (rev provenance L9-area, section 5 reuse inventory instrument-fact, section 6.1 seed annotation) and the machine annotation 'contentInert: true' is at L182 in the protocol.json spec. Seed inertness documented at all touchpoints.

verificationEvidence.command: git show HEAD:...plan.md | grep -n 'never outcome-judging'; | grep -n 'no model'
verificationEvidence.note: L272 section 6.5 header contains the exact phrase 'never outcome-judging'; L274 body states 'The OUTCOME judge is deterministic code (analyze-batch.mjs); no model — Claude or Codex — ever judges a hypothesis.' Cross-vendor fairness rule intact as the operator decided.

verificationEvidence.command: git show HEAD:...plan.md | grep -n 'recordDigest field absent (preimage frozen in protocol.json)'; | grep -n 'accidental'; | grep -n 'signing is Tier-C, out of scope'
verificationEvidence.note: L241-242 define recordDigest = sha256 of canonical JSON with the recordDigest field absent, preimage frozen in protocol.json. L107-110 (section 3) scope ledger self-digests to 'accidental corruption and naive edits only' with cryptographic signing deferred to Tier-C; L245 (section 6.2) repeats 'signing is Tier-C, out of scope'. No ledger-integrity overclaim.

verificationEvidence.command: git show HEAD:...plan.md | grep -n 'Not-evaluable trigger'; | grep -n 'supported / falsified'; | grep -n 'all four'
verificationEvidence.note: L123 section 4 table has the 'Not-evaluable trigger' column with exactly three verdict states (L118-119 'supported / falsified / not-evaluable'); L121 'the section 3 claim requires all four SUPPORTED verbatim' and L352 section 10 'Allowed if all four hypotheses are SUPPORTED'; L382 section 12 repeats three-state in the final-summary DoD. Three-state discipline end-to-end.
